extras: Code readability and extensibility are limited.
intentEvidence: So, with the help of Cursor + Claude, I combined code from obsidian-paste-image-rename and obsidian-paste-png-to-jpeg into one plugin.
motivation: The author combined existing solutions to meet specific requirements: renaming pasted images, compressing them, and automatically uploading them to Cloudflare R2 object storage.
problem: Users need a way to automatically rename, compress, and store images when they are pasted into Obsidian notes.

relations.evidence: This plugin is inspired by and based on the following repositories: - obsidian-paste-image-rename
Found that plugin obsidian-image-upload perfectly solves this

summary: A plugin that renames pasted images, converts formats, compresses them, and automatically uploads them to Cloudflare R2 object storage.
